sample_unit: participants (65 older adult patients, 32 informal caregivers)

links.outcome: Acceptability (AES) and usability (SUS) across iterative design waves with structured user feedback
links.effect: Acceptability rose from 15.4/30 (wave 1) to 22.5/30 (wave 3), P<.001; usability from 47.9/100 to 69.3/100, P<.001, after successive system enhancements including LLM integration.
links.quote: Successive system enhancements, most notably the integration of an LLM, led to measurable gains in usability and acceptability among patients and informal caregivers.

unlisted_practices: Iterative user-centered design of a socially assistive robot with LLM-based dialogue for older adults in a geriatric day hospital

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of real deployment of an LLM-integrated humanoid robot interacting with older adult patients and caregivers in a geriatric day care hospital waiting area.
